items.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016
items.q: And we were on it and Ray Charles was on it and a bunch of great people.

ctx.x: And did he have like chord charts or did he have lines for you?

It was a combination of both. He had certain things that were very specific parts, but most of the tunes were kind of basic chord charts with certain lines written in. And what was great about that gig for me was that after all these years of playing in more of a pop — with singers per se. With Chuck’s band you had to understand bebop, Latin, we did certain orchestra dates so you had to kind of be able to play the orchestra book. And for me it was a blowing gig.
